verdict.seen: The channel is dug and water is visible. A plank then lies across the top with a small cart beside it. The sequence goes from an open channel to a plank laid across it.
A cart with a stone block rolls onto the plank. The plank breaks in the middle and its far half tilts down into the channel.
A stone pier rises in the river, but no slabs are laid on top in any frame. The broken plank is visible only in the first frame.
verdict.problem: No flat slabs are laid on the pier, so add slabs resting on top of the pier.

verdict.seen: This is a single frame with only a lone pier in the river. There is no slab and no crack.
verdict.problem: There is no deck slab and no crack splitting it, so show a long slab across the piers with a visible crack underneath.

verdict.seen: Only a single pier stands in the water in all three frames. There is no wooden frame, wedge stones or keystone, and nothing changes.
verdict.problem: No arch construction is shown, so add a wooden frame, wedge stones curving over it and a keystone.

verdict.seen: A yellow rectangular outline floats above the ground over a lone pier. No arch exists, and the outline is a flat box that does not trace an arch.
verdict.problem: There is no arch to outline, and the outline floats in the air, so build the arch and wrap the glow around it.

verdict.seen: A lone pier is shown with yellow arrows around it. There is no arch and no block on a crown, and the arrows do not run along a curve.
verdict.problem: There is no arch, no load block on the crown and no arrows running down a curve into the piers, so add them.

verdict.seen: All three frames are identical: a lone pier with no frame and no arch. Nothing is pulled away.
verdict.problem: No arch or wooden frame is present, so show the frame being removed with the arch standing alone.

verdict.seen: A flat road slab with low walls appears on the single pier, but no arches support it and no cart is seen crossing.
verdict.problem: The deck sits on a single pier with no arches and no cart, so add arches under the road and a cart rolling across.

verdict.seen: The finished build is a flat slab with side walls on one pier, shown as the camera pulls back. It is not an arch bridge.
verdict.problem: The bridge has no arch, so show the complete arch bridge in full view.
